title: Committed .blend binaries embed absolute /Users/moses/... paths (render filepath + file-browser recents) — the leak class this PR's N3 fold scrubbed from docs
evidence: zstd-decompressed committed blobs (files start 28 b5 2f fd, "BLENDER" after decompress) contain, via `strings`: `/Users/moses/.herdr/worktrees/packet-plumber/packet-plumber-v2-blender-sculpt/assets/blender/wip/r3_campus.png` (campus; per-family: r2_house_0.png, r3_dc.png, r3_host.png, r3_puck_3.png, r3_small_biz.png) plus file-browser recent-path fragments `/Users/moses`, `zquez/`, `lender/`, `.80/`, `onfig/`. The PR body (_pr_body.md:44) claims the fold: "N3 (no /Users paths in committed docs)".
detail: The 6 new committed binaries ship the user's absolute home/worktree paths (username, machine layout) inside saved RenderSettings.filepath and file-browser state — exactly the /Users-path class the repo rules against; N3 cleaned the docs only.
recommended_fix: Before committing .blends: clear scene.render.filepath (or set blend-relative "//"), purge file-browser recents, resave; re-verify the double-run byte-identity after the resave.

title: Embedded-script auto-run defense is a README policy note, not enforced by the documented pipeline command or gen_sprites.py
evidence: README: "**Security note:** these are plain sculpted files — no embedded Python / text-blocks. Blender's auto-run of embedded scripts must stay OFF for third-party `.blend` files; the pipeline never needs it." Invocation (README:61, docs/silhouette-spec.md:116, gen_sprites.py docstring:32): `blender -b -P tools/gen_sprites.py` — no --disable-autoexec. tools/gen_sprites.py:237: `bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=os.path.join(BLEND_DIR, family + ".blend"))` with no use_scripts_auto_execute=False set anywhere.
detail: The pipeline executes committed, review-opaque compressed binaries (a malicious .blend needs no readable code change); protection against embedded-script/driver auto-exec depends on each runner's Blender preference state rather than the pipeline itself.
recommended_fix: Pin `blender -b --disable-autoexec -P tools/gen_sprites.py` in README/spec/docstring, and/or set bpy.context.preferences.filepaths.use_scripts_auto_execute = False in gen_sprites.py before the first open_mainfile.

title: All 6 committed .blends reference an unidentifiable hash-named external JPG absent from the repo and worktree
evidence: `strings` on each zstd-decompressed .blend: `0dac0b05ae44d0d8663c049cdde90b2ced7ef559_1_500x500.jpg` (identical in all 6; in house.blend.raw at offsets 67797, 75693, 142583, 153167, 188159, 232368, 257072, 283040, NUL-padded filepath fields). No matching file anywhere in the repo or the sculpting worktree (`find`/`mdfind` negative); no image bytes embedded (zero JPEG/PNG SOI markers in the decompressed data).
detail: The committed sources are the IP-guardrail 'record', yet each carries a dangling image-datablock reference to an unexplained external thumbnail — provenance undocumented and the sources not self-contained. No third-party bytes ship.
recommended_fix: Purge the unused image datablock from the .blends (File→Clean Up→Purge), resave, and document what the reference was in the PR body.

title: lint-gated test evals gen_sprites.py's SPRITE_SPECS AST with full builtins
detail: No untrusted boundary today — the input is the repo's own source, executed directly by the pipeline anyway — but eval (not literal_eval) on a mutable file executes arbitrary call expressions at lint time.
recommended_fix: Make SPRITE_SPECS literal_eval-able (inline the hex strings, cross-check against HOUSE_COLORS) or eval with {"__builtins__": {}, "HOUSE_COLORS": colors}.
